property: a single established documentation prefix is expanded into three coordinated example networks so multi-network examples can avoid colliding with deployed addresses.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 5737 cites RFC 1166 for TEST-NET-1 and adds two more blocks

sources.supports: TEST-NET-1 ancestry and three-block documentation family

negative_claims: Historical use of an arbitrary address range in examples does not make that range formally reserved for documentation.
open_questions: Create a dedicated RFC 1166 source record and document earlier example-address practices.
